raw_html: [[Relentless Fury]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Relentless Fury]]''': While this item is equipped, any killing blows you strike against enemies may drive you into a furious rage, providing a 5% Enhancement damage bonus to your melee, ranged and unarmed attacks for 30 seconds. Slaying weaker opponents has a reduced chance of producing this effect.
